# ImageColorSpace

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

PDF color space for images

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `DeviceRGB`: RGB color space (3 components: red, green, blue)
- `DeviceCMYK`: CMYK color space (4 components: cyan, magenta, yellow, black)
- `DeviceGray`: Grayscale color space (1 component)
- `Indexed`: Indexed color space (palette-based)
